description.zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain the instance ID.

description.zh:
指定要修改的控制策略的ID。

> 您可以调用[ListPolicies](~~2758876~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the control policy that you want to modify.

> Call the [ListPolicies](~~2758876~~) operation to obtain the policy ID.

description.zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the region where the Bastionhost instance resides.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

title.zh: 设置指定控制策略的协议控制配置

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost set-policy-protocol-config --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id 61 --protocol-config '{"SSH":{"SFTPUploadFile":"Enable","SFTPMkdir":"Enable","SSHChannel":"Enable","SFTPRmdir":"Enable","SFTPChannel":"Enable","AllowDirectTcp":"Enable","SFTPRemoveFile":"Enable","X11Forwarding":"Enable","SFTPDownloadFile":"Enable","AllowTcpForwarding":"Enable","ExecCommand":"Enable","TcpForwarding":"Enable","SFTPRenameFile":"Enable"},"RDP":{"RecordKeyboard":"Enable","ClipboardUpload":"Enable","DiskRedirectionDownload":"Enable","DiskRedirection":"Enable","DiskRedirectionUpload":"Enable","ClipboardDownload":"Enable"}}' --region cn-hangzhou
